color.$description: Primitive color ramps — raw values only, no meaning. Derived in OKLCH per D-006. Traceable to D-001 (Braun-derived warm mood, single accent) and D-006 (neutral warm ramp from cream, brand orange/coral ramp, desaturated role ramps).

neutral.$description: Warm neutral ramp — SUPERSEDES the D-006-era ramp (hue ~75°) per D-028 (dial-braun-rederivation). Hue corrected to ~100° (measured directly from the Braun reference image's cream body via real pixel sampling: OKLCH L≈0.87-0.88, C≈0.011, H≈106-107° — the old 75° hue was a judgment call made without a reference image to sample; this ramp keeps Dial's existing lightness ladder, which measurement did not show wrong, and only corrects hue+chroma to match the measured reference). Extra steps 0/25/975 kept for surface ladder (braun-flat.md).

brand.$description: Accent orange/coral ramp — SUPERSEDES the D-006-era ramp per D-028 (dial-braun-rederivation). Anchor: 500 = #E67734-family at OKLCH(L=0.676, C=0.160, H=42.5°), measured directly from the Braun reference image (a real pixel sample of the audio1 knob's flat fill, cross-checked against a broader scan of every orange region across 22 reference devices — both converge on the same value). The OLD ramp's anchor (#E8622D) was already close in hue/chroma, but D-014's later contrast fix silently collapsed chroma at brand.700 (the step actually used for interactive default) from a would-be ~0.16 down to 0.149 while also darkening it — a side effect of solving lightness for contrast that nobody re-checked against the reference afterward. This ramp holds the FULL measured reference chroma (C≈0.16) constant through the entire vivid mid-range (300-800), tapering only at the extremes where sRGB gamut physically cannot hold that chroma at that lightness — so the AA-safe interactive step (700, light theme) is now the reference's actual vivid orange, not a muted brick. Reserved for single most-important interactive element per view (D-001 accent scarcity — this rule is UNCHANGED, only saturation/lightness at each step changed).

success.$description: Standard green hue, desaturated to fit calm Braun mood (D-006). No specific decision anchors exact hex — derived judgment call using same ramp construction as brand.

warning.$description: Standard amber/gold hue, desaturated (D-006). Derived judgment call.

danger.$description: Standard red hue, desaturated (D-006). Derived judgment call.

info.$description: Standard blue hue, desaturated (D-006). Derived judgment call.

base.$description: Pure white/black for on-accent text and scrims — not part of any hue ramp.
